reviews.author: Taylor Dreitlein
reviews.text: I have been seeing Dr. Sheila for 3 years now and her + the entire Sutton Advanced Cosmetic Dentistry staff have been the absolute best! My veneers turned out so beautiful and natural and I am extremely happy with the condition of my teeth.

reviews.author: Zach A
reviews.text: My dentist for life. Amazing practice, great location and space, technically skilled, and most importantly the best and most assuring dispositions. I would literally never go anywhere else. A+++

reviews.author: Anna Chen
reviews.text: Five stars – and were it possible, I'd add a sixth. After two other dentists told me I would probably need about ten visits and multiple tooth removals, Dr. Fajiram calmly and patiently described that much of what I had been told was definitely not necessary.

reviews.author: Ronit Delrahim
reviews.text: I have always hated my smile for as long as I can remember. As a child, I chipped my front teeth in a bad accident. Dr Sheila changed that for me this year! I went from a wrecked smile to a celebrity smile.

reviews.author: Nadia Arabian
reviews.text: Dr. Fajiram is a professional, educated, kind, experienced and patient. She made sure that my veneers were perfect and comfortable. I'm obsessed with the color and look of my smile.

reviews.author: Samantha Tiran
reviews.text: Sutton Advanced is the best! It is precision care and such great personal attention. The staff is so helpful and you are always treated with respect and care.

reviews.author: Indra Teka
reviews.text: I found Dr. Fajiram and Dr. Monahemi through Instagram. I initially went in for a consultation for my husband and ended his visit with one for myself. The staff was amazing and made us feel very welcomed.

reviews.author: Onyx Opus
reviews.text: I had beautiful & natural veneers done with Dr. Sheila. She removed the old ones, took care of a cavity that was forming and made my teeth look amazing. She was wonderful from beginning to end.

reviews.author: Matteo Prodani
reviews.text: Great service and great attitude. Everyone is knowledgeable and happy to assist. Beautiful space and perfect location.
